data.name: Rudresh
data.gender_notes: Rudresh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rudra is the name of the Hindu god Shiva, the god of destruction and regeneration. He is also known as the 'Lord of the Dance'. Rudresh is a variant of Rudra and means 'God of Rudra'. The name Rudresh carries the meaning “God of Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rudresh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rudresh is a name that embodies the power and strength of the Hindu god Shiva. It is a name that resonates with the energies of destruction and regeneration, and is a powerful reminder of the cyclical nature of the universe.
data.etymology: Rudresh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rudresh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: Rudresh is a powerful name rooted in Hinduism, symbolizing strength, power, and destruction. The name has been mentioned in numerous Hindu scriptures, and Rudra, the god it represents, is an essential deity in Hinduism, influencing the religious practices, mythology, arts, and traditions of Hindu communities worldwide.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rudresh holds significant spiritual relevance as it represents Lord Shiva, the supreme deity of the Hindu trinity. Shiva is the personification of the universal cycles of creation, preservation, and destruction. He is considered the patron of yoga, arts, and sciences, and his worship brings peace, protection, and prosperity to an individual. The name Rudresh serves as a constant reminder of one's connection to the divine, inspiring reverence, devotion, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rudresh is a name revered in Hinduism, symbolizing the auspicious presence of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and transformation, within the self. It is a reminder to embrace change and face life's challenges with courage and resilience.
